title: Raadinta Maxkamadda
intro: Waddooyinka awoodda, qof darajo sare leh ayaa ku qancay addoon quruxdiisu ay ahayd mid aan adduunyo ahayn. Jacaylkan wuxuu horseeday dhacdooyin taxane ah oo tijaabin doona daacadnimada, soo bandhigi doona runta qarsoon, ugu dambayntiina xaqiijin doona daahirnimada addoonka.
clues: Waxaan ku noolaa dhulka Niil, qasri saameyn weyn leh.
Nin dhallinyaro ah ayaa gurigayga soo galay, joogitaankiisuna wuxuu khalkhal geliyay adduunkaygii.
Waan isku dayay inaan sasabo, laakiin wuxuu magan galay Rabbigiis.
Dharkiisii ​​ayaan ka jeexjeexay gadaashiisa, laakiin caddayntu waxay tilmaamaysay khiyaanadaydii.
Si aan u aamusiyo xanta dumarka sharafta leh, waxaan ku casuumay kulan waxaana gacmahooda ku riday walxo fiiqan.
Ugu dambeyntii, si cad ayaan u qirtay qaladkayga, anigoo runta ka hor qiray boqorka.

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Waxay isku dayday inay sasabto Nabi Yuusuf
Waxay isku dayday inay disho Nabi Muuse
Waxay dhistay munaarad si ay Alle ugu babac dhigto
Waxay hoggaaminaysay ciidan ka soo horjeeda Makka
trial.answer: Waxay isku dayday inay sasabto Nabi Yuusuf

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Waxaa la qarqiyay ciidankeedii iyadoo la socota
Waxay isu beddeshay tiir cusbo ah

arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
